name: Food insecurity rate
source: County Health Rankings & Roadmaps 2025 County Health Release, Monterey County, California (Map the Meal Gap measure)
notes: The CHR 2025 county-layer row for FIPS 06053 reports v139_rawvalue = 13 (% of population), with v139_numerator = 56,940. Its field description identifies Map the Meal Gap and explicitly dates this value to 2022. CHR's measure page defines this as a modeled percentage of the population lacking reliable food access and says the denominator is total county population: https://www.countyhealthrankings.org/health-data/community-conditions/health-infrastructure/health-promotion-and-harm-reduction/food-insecurity. The exact query, year, field descriptions, and Monterey values appear in the archived source text at apps/web/public/evidence/monterey-county/evidence/7340038b7e846424.txt; raw row JSON is also preserved at apps/web/public/evidence/monterey-county/evidence/37056c673ae97ec8.bin (SHA-256 e03064c1cee2c9e9500b5906f518569999a41a9bbf1a15a116adf1751c7c3136). Readable extract: research/carmel-monterey-2026-10-18/monterey-county/exhibits/chr-2025-monterey-row.csv. This modeled all-population measure is distinct from the County CHNA's self-reported household food-stress construct.
